design_philosophy: Hardcore souls-like co-op ARPG with tactical Warcraft 3-inspired combat roles and precise execution windows.

spells.name: Bulwark Impact
spells.tactical_role: High-priority direct interrupt. Generates massive threat (300% multiplier); use instantly when boss starts windup for wipe mechanics.

spells.name: Iron Bastion
spells.tactical_role: Mitigation stance granting 65% damage reduction and stability for 5 seconds; essential before soaking unblockable boss cleaves.

spells.name: Condemning Brand
spells.tactical_role: AoE taunt that applies a 10% physical/elemental vulnerability debuff for 8 seconds, setting up burst windows for the Spellblade.

spells.name: Grace of the Sanctum
spells.tactical_role: High-risk, high-throughput single-target burst heal. Severe cast time punishment requires strict positioning during heavy mechanics.

spells.name: Martyr's Shield
spells.tactical_role: Emergency reaction button. Applies an instant flat damage barrier and prevents poise break on the target for 3 seconds.

spells.name: Sanctified Zone
spells.tactical_role: Targeted 8-meter AoE field ticking healing for 8 seconds. Restores 5 stamina per second to allies inside, facilitating DPS rotations.

spells.name: Rift Thrust
spells.tactical_role: Combo starter. Pierces armor and applies 'Resonance' for 6 seconds. Generates 1 Charge of Arcane Flux.

spells.name: Glacial Convergence
spells.tactical_role: Combo bridge. Consumes 'Resonance' to deal 50% bonus damage and reduce the target's attack speed by 20% for 4 seconds.

spells.name: Void Shatter
spells.tactical_role: Finisher and backup interrupt. Consumes all Arcane Flux charges to amplify damage up to 100%. Deals heavy stagger to poise bars.

phases.title: Slumbering Titan
phases.description: Slow, predictable telegraphed physical swings. Tests basic tank positioning, stamina management, and DPS timing around recovery frames.

phases.title: Molten Awakening
phases.description: The Colossus vents superheated core energy. Arena hazard rings form. Boss gains increased movement speed and introduces fatal channeled casts.

phases.title: Cataclysmic Collapse
phases.description: Soft enrage. Boss continuously radiates pulsing room-wide damage while alternating rapid slams. Demands simultaneous group coordination and burst DPS.

telegraphed_attacks.name: Tectonic Cleave
telegraphed_attacks.counterplay: Templar turns boss away from group. DPS and Healer position behind. Tank must execute an active dodge-roll through the swing or pop Iron Bastion.

telegraphed_attacks.name: Core Detonation
telegraphed_attacks.counterplay: Full-arena lethal wipe mechanic. The boss gains a 3-stack Poise Armor shield. Requires 2 interrupts (e.g., Templar Bulwark Impact + Spellblade Void Shatter) within 4.5s to break channel.

telegraphed_attacks.name: Shattering Quake
telegraphed_attacks.counterplay: Rapid radial point-blank AoE. Melee characters must quickly roll outward during the 0.3s iframe window; Cleric must pre-cast Sanctified Zone to catch residual shockwave damage.
